mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM department WHERE status='ACTIVE'), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doctor d JOIN department dp ON dp.id=d.department_id WHERE d.status='ACTIVE' AND dp.status='ACTIVE'), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doctor_schedule sc JOIN doctor d ON d.id=sc.doctor_id JOIN department dp ON dp.id=d.department_id WHERE sc.status='OPEN' AND d.status='ACTIVE' AND dp.status='ACTIVE' AND sc.schedule_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM appointment_slot s WHERE s.schedule_id=sc.id AND s.status='AVAILABLE' AND s.start_at > #{now}))
